name: Shinei "Undertaker" Nouzen's M1A4 Juggernaut
author: Phuriphan3D
description:
Produced as part of a University Assignment.
Low Poly game model.
2048 x 2048 textures.
Used AUTODESK MAYA, Adobe Substance 3D Painter, and Adobe Photoshop.
It uses 5 UDIMs, sadly SketchFab doesn't support it.
I will put this up on my ArtStation with renders soon with the textures.
note: Prefer glTF via osgconv; fallback pure-python glTF; textures in textures/
